sources.title: deer-sec/CyberStag-26B-A4B-v1-optiq8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview CyberStag-26B-A4B-v1 is a highly specialized, text-only large language model designed explicitly for cybersecurity analysis and deep logical reasoning. Built upon the robust Gemma-4-26B-A4B architecture (MoE), this model has been fine-tuned using mlx_lm.lora to excel in understanding complex security domains.

sources.title: REDCELL-26B-A4B-OSINT-Cyber-APEX-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A supervised fine-tune of Gemma 4 26B-A4B, oriented towards open-source intelligence, cyber threat intelligence, and investigative journalism. Overview REDCELL is a supervised fine-tune (SFT) of Google's Gemma 4 26B-A4B (Mixture-of-Experts, MoE), trained to produce senior-analyst tradecraft instead of reflexive hedging on legitimate investigative work.
